name: @slopmax/net
description: Outbound HTTP (pooling, proxies, origins), WebSocket and form helpers
//: No dependencies beyond effect and @slopmax/common. Bun's fetch and Bun.serve do the HTTP. Node modules both Bun and Node have: node:net, node:tls, node:dns, and node:os (errno numbers) in conn.ts, socks.ts, and client.ts, for upgraded connections, the SOCKS5 bridge, and the connect timeout; node:http in server.ts only to raise the request-head limit; node:fs, node:child_process, and node:process in server.ts for portHolder; node:crypto in ws.ts for SHA-1; node:buffer in client.ts, socks.ts, and ws.ts for base64, hex, and latin1.
